chunks: Fight those who do not believe in God and the Last Day, who do not prohibit what God and His Apostle have forbidden, nor accept the religion of truth from among the People of the Book, until they pay the jizyah tax in submission.

key_terms.الْجِزْيَة: Protective tax paid by non-Muslim subjects
key_terms.عَنْ يَدٍ: With their own hands (indicating direct payment and dignity/submission)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of jizyah and the condition of 'saghrun' (submission) in Surah At-Tawbah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah At-Tawbah is often viewed as the primary textual basis for the political subordination of Ahl al-Kitab, with the term 'saghirun' (humble/submissive) interpreted as a state of paying tribute rather than mere humiliation. It establishes the jizyah as a covenantal mechanism that secures protection and religious autonomy for monotheistic communities within the Islamic polity, contingent upon their acceptance of Islamic sovereignty.
